## Values

```{r}
# ===========================================================================
# SUMMARY VALUES FOR THE PANEL A DESCRIPTION
# ===========================================================================
 
pp  <- \(x) sprintf("%.1f", 100 * x)      # proportion as a percentage
ppd <- \(x) sprintf("%+.1f", 100 * x)     # change in percentage points
 
wk_first <- min(lines_region$week)
wk_last  <- max(lines_region$week)
 
c(as.character(wk_first), as.character(wk_last))   # the period being described
 
# ---- 1. Start, end, and change for every region and series ----------------
 
ends <- lines_region |>
  filter(week %in% c(wk_first, wk_last)) |>
  mutate(point = if_else(week == wk_first, "start", "end")) |>
  select(series, region, point, value) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = point, values_from = value) |>
  mutate(change_pp = 100 * (end - start)) |>
  arrange(series, desc(end))
 
ends |> print(n = Inf)
 
# ---- 2. Leading and trailing region, and the spread between them ----------
 
extremes <- lines_region |>
  filter(week %in% c(wk_first, wk_last)) |>
  mutate(point = factor(if_else(week == wk_first, "Start", "End"),
                        levels = c("Start", "End"))) |>
  summarise(
    highest   = as.character(region[which.max(value)]),
    high_val  = max(value),
    lowest    = as.character(region[which.min(value)]),
    low_val   = min(value),
    spread_pp = 100 * (max(value) - min(value)),
    .by = c(series, point)
  ) |>
  arrange(series, point)
 
extremes |> print(n = Inf)
 
# did the ranking of regions change between start and end?
lines_region |>
  filter(week %in% c(wk_first, wk_last)) |>
  mutate(point = if_else(week == wk_first, "start", "end"),
         rk    = rank(-value), .by = c(series, week)) |>
  select(series, region, point, rk) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = point, values_from = rk) |>
  filter(start != end) |>
  print(n = Inf)
 
# ---- 3. EVC with its uncertainty interval --------------------------------
 
evc_ci <- rib_region |>
  filter(week %in% c(wk_first, wk_last)) |>
  left_join(lines_region |>
              filter(series == x_labels[["EVC"]]) |>
              select(week, group, evc = value),
            by = c("week", "group")) |>
  mutate(point    = factor(if_else(week == wk_first, "Start", "End"),
                           levels = c("Start", "End")),
         width_pp = 100 * (evc_hi - evc_lo),
         lab      = sprintf("%s%% (%s to %s%%)", pp(evc), pp(evc_lo), pp(evc_hi))) |>
  select(region, point, evc, evc_lo, evc_hi, width_pp, lab) |>
  arrange(point, desc(evc))
 
evc_ci |> print(n = Inf)
 
# band width across the whole period: all regions share the same draws, so
# this is VE-parameter uncertainty, not between-region precision
rib_region |>
  summarise(width_min = 100 * min(evc_hi - evc_lo),
            width_med = 100 * median(evc_hi - evc_lo),
            width_max = 100 * max(evc_hi - evc_lo))
 
# ---- 4. Gap between MCV1 coverage and estimated immunity -----------------
# The vertical distance between the two lines is primary vaccine failure
# plus waning, expressed in percentage points.
 
gap <- lines_region |>
  filter(series %in% unname(x_labels[c("Dose 1", "EVC")])) |>
  select(week, region, series, value) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = series, values_from = value) |>
  rename(mcv1 = !!x_labels[["Dose 1"]], evc = !!x_labels[["EVC"]]) |>
  mutate(gap_pp = 100 * (mcv1 - evc))
 
gap |>
  summarise(gap_start = gap_pp[which.min(week)],
            gap_end   = gap_pp[which.max(week)],
            gap_min   = min(gap_pp),
            gap_max   = max(gap_pp),
            .by = region) |>
  print(n = Inf)
 
# ---- 5. Largest week-on-week step, e.g. the early-2024 jump --------------
 
lines_region |>
  arrange(region, series, week) |>
  mutate(step_pp = 100 * (value - lag(value)), .by = c(region, series)) |>
  slice_max(step_pp, n = 1, by = c(region, series)) |>
  select(series, region, week, step_pp) |>
  arrange(series, desc(step_pp)) |>
  print(n = Inf)
 
# ---- 6. Sentence-ready strings -------------------------------------------
 
ends |>
  mutate(txt = sprintf("%s, %s: %s%% to %s%% (%s pp)",
                       series, region, pp(start), pp(end), ppd(end - start))) |>
  pull(txt) |>
  writeLines()
 
evc_ci |>
  filter(point == "End") |>
  mutate(txt = sprintf("%s: EVC %s", region, lab)) |>
  pull(txt) |>
  writeLines()
```

## Values sero vs cov

```{r}
# ===========================================================================
# SUMMARY VALUES FOR THE PANEL C DESCRIPTION
# ===========================================================================
 
pp <- \(x) sprintf("%.1f", 100 * x)
 
# ---- 1. Seroprevalence by region, with sample sizes -----------------------
# Same sera for MCV1 and EVC (9-59 mo); MCV2 uses 18-59 mo, so its
# seroprevalence and n differ.
 
scat |>
  select(metric, region, x_pos, n_sero, sero, sero_lo, sero_hi) |>
  mutate(lab = sprintf("%s%% (%s to %s%%), %d/%d",
                       pp(sero), pp(sero_lo), pp(sero_hi), x_pos, n_sero)) |>
  arrange(metric, desc(sero)) |>
  print(n = Inf)
 
# range across regions, per age window
scat |>
  summarise(n_regions = n(),
            n_sera    = sum(n_sero),
            sero_min  = min(sero), sero_max = max(sero),
            reg_min   = as.character(region[which.min(sero)]),
            reg_max   = as.character(region[which.max(sero)]),
            .by = metric) |>
  print(n = Inf)
 
# widest and narrowest confidence intervals, which drive how much the
# scatter can be read at all
scat |>
  mutate(ci_pp = 100 * (sero_hi - sero_lo)) |>
  slice_max(ci_pp, n = 1, by = metric) |>
  select(metric, region, n_sero, sero, ci_pp) |>
  print(n = Inf)
 
# ---- 2. The x metrics: period value and temporal range -------------------
 
scat |>
  mutate(lab = sprintf("%s%% (range %s to %s%%)", pp(x), pp(x_lo), pp(x_hi))) |>
  select(metric, region, x, x_lo, x_hi, lab) |>
  arrange(metric, desc(x)) |>
  print(n = Inf)
 
scat |>
  summarise(x_min = min(x), x_max = max(x),
            spread_pp = 100 * (max(x) - min(x)),
            reg_min = as.character(region[which.min(x)]),
            reg_max = as.character(region[which.max(x)]),
            .by = metric) |>
  print(n = Inf)
 
# EVC parameter interval, which only the EVC panel carries
scat |>
  filter(!is.na(xu_lo)) |>
  mutate(u_pp = 100 * (xu_hi - xu_lo)) |>
  select(metric, region, x, xu_lo, xu_hi, u_pp) |>
  print(n = Inf)
 
# ---- 3. The gap: how far every point sits below the 1:1 line -------------
# This is the dominant feature of panel C and the number to lead with.
 
scat |>
  mutate(gap_pp = 100 * (x - sero)) |>
  summarise(gap_med = median(gap_pp),
            gap_min = min(gap_pp), gap_max = max(gap_pp),
            n_above = sum(gap_pp < 0),          # regions above the 1:1 line
            .by = metric) |>
  print(n = Inf)
 
# per region, for the metric-specific sentences
scat |>
  mutate(gap_pp = 100 * (x - sero)) |>
  select(metric, region, x, sero, gap_pp) |>
  arrange(metric, desc(gap_pp)) |>
  print(n = Inf)
 
# does any region's seroprevalence CI reach its x value?
scat |>
  filter(sero_hi >= x) |>
  select(metric, region, x, sero, sero_hi) |>
  print(n = Inf)
 
# ---- 4. Do the two axes rank the regions the same way? -------------------
# Ranking agreement is the descriptive version of the correlation, and is
# more honest than a p-value at n = 5.
 
scat |>
  mutate(rk_x = rank(-x), rk_y = rank(-sero), .by = metric) |>
  select(metric, region, rk_x, rk_y) |>
  arrange(metric, rk_x) |>
  print(n = Inf)
 
scat |>
  summarise(rho = cor(x, sero, method = "spearman"),
            n_concordant = sum(rank(-x) == rank(-sero)),
            .by = metric) |>
  print(n = Inf)
 
# ---- 5. Sentence-ready strings -------------------------------------------
 
scat |>
  filter(metric == x_labels[["EVC"]]) |>
  mutate(txt = sprintf("%s: EVC %s%%, seroprevalence %s%% (%s to %s%%), gap %.1f pp",
                       region, pp(x), pp(sero), pp(sero_lo), pp(sero_hi),
                       100 * (x - sero))) |>
  arrange(desc(x)) |>
  pull(txt) |>
  writeLines()
```


## Sero vs cum inc

```{r}
# ===========================================================================
# 12. REGION-LEVEL CUMULATIVE INCIDENCE, BY BIN
# ===========================================================================
# Region incidence is recomputed from summed cases and population, not
# averaged across district rates.

sero_age_lo <- 9 / 12      # years; matches the EVC denominator
sero_age_hi <- 5
 
bin_keep <- as.Date(c("2024-07-01", "2024-10-01", "2025-01-01",
                      "2025-04-01", "2025-07-01", "2025-10-01"))
 
inc_src <- map_snapshot |>
  as_tibble() |>
  mutate(bin = as.Date(bin), region = assign_region(district)) |>
  filter(bin %in% bin_keep)
 
setdiff(unique(inc_src$district), levels(child$district))
 
inc_all <- inc_src |>
  summarise(cum_n = sum(cum_n), n_census = sum(n_census), .by = c(region, bin)) |>
  mutate(
    group  = as.character(region),
    inc    = cum_n / n_census * 1e5,
    inc_lo = qchisq(0.025, 2 * cum_n) / 2 / n_census * 1e5,
    inc_hi = qchisq(0.975, 2 * (cum_n + 1)) / 2 / n_census * 1e5
  )
 
inc_all |> select(group, bin, cum_n, inc) |> arrange(bin, group) |> print(n = Inf)
 
# ===========================================================================
# 13. IMMUNITY MEASURES VS CUMULATIVE INCIDENCE, REGION LEVEL
# ===========================================================================
# Rows are the pre-outbreak immunity measures, columns the outbreak bins, so
# each row shows how one measure's association with incidence develops as the
# outbreak accumulates. Every panel has five points.
 
snap_week   <- max(weeks)     # last study week; coverage and EVC snapshot
n_min_round <- 5              # minimum sera per region within the last round
common_only <- TRUE
 
hosp_col <- "hospital"        # <- set to your hospital column name
 
# ---- last collection period, defined within each hospital -----------------
 
sero_src |>                                   # verify the ordering first
  count(.data[[hosp_col]], period_collect) |>
  print(n = Inf)
 
sero_last <- sero_src |>
  filter(period_collect == max(period_collect), .by = all_of(hosp_col))
 
sero_last |>                                  # which period each hospital gave
  summarise(period = first(period_collect), n = n(), .by = all_of(hosp_col))
 
sero_last |>
  filter(age_y >= sero_age_lo, age_y < sero_age_hi) |>
  count(region) |>
  print(n = Inf)
 
sero_snap <- sero_last |>
  filter(age_y >= sero_age_lo, age_y < sero_age_hi) |>
  mutate(region = as.character(region)) |>
  sero_ci("region") |>
  filter(n_sero >= n_min_round)
 
# ---- coverage and EVC at the snapshot week --------------------------------
 
metric_lev <- c(unname(x_labels), "Seroprevalence")
 
x_all <- bind_rows(
  ser_region$cov |>
    filter(week == snap_week) |>
    transmute(group  = as.character(group),
              metric = unname(x_labels[as.character(dose)]),
              x = coverage, x_lo = NA_real_, x_hi = NA_real_),
  ser_region$evc |>
    filter(week == snap_week) |>
    transmute(group  = as.character(group),
              metric = x_labels[["EVC"]],
              x = evc, x_lo = evc_lo, x_hi = evc_hi),
  sero_snap |>
    transmute(group = as.character(group), metric = "Seroprevalence",
              x = sero, x_lo = sero_lo, x_hi = sero_hi)
)
 
if (common_only) {
  keep <- x_all |>
    summarise(k = n_distinct(metric), .by = group) |>
    filter(k == length(metric_lev))
  x_all <- x_all |> semi_join(keep, by = "group")
}
 
bin_lab <- setNames(format(bin_keep, "%b %Y"), as.character(bin_keep))
 
dat_inc <- x_all |>
  inner_join(inc_all |> select(group, bin, region, inc, inc_lo, inc_hi),
             by = "group") |>
  mutate(metric = factor(metric, levels = metric_lev),
         region = factor(as.character(region), levels = rank_order),
         bin    = factor(bin_lab[as.character(bin)], levels = unname(bin_lab)))
 
dat_inc |> summarise(n = n(), .by = c(metric, bin)) |> print(n = Inf)
 
# ---- Spearman rho ---------------------------------------------------------
# n = 5 in every panel, and the six bins are nested cumulative counts, so
# these are not six independent tests. Treat the row as a trajectory.
 
cor_inc_all <- dat_inc |>
  summarise(
    n   = sum(is.finite(x) & is.finite(inc)),
    rho = if (n[1] >= 3) cor(x, inc, method = "spearman",
                             use = "complete.obs") else NA_real_,
    p   = if (n[1] >= 3) suppressWarnings(
            cor.test(x, inc, method = "spearman", exact = FALSE)$p.value
          ) else NA_real_,
    .by = c(metric, bin)
  ) |>
  mutate(lab = if_else(is.na(rho), "rho = NA",
                       sprintf("rho = %.2f\np = %.3f", rho, p)))
 
cor_inc_all |> print(n = Inf)
 
# ---- figure ---------------------------------------------------------------
# x varies by row and y by column, which is the opposite of what facet_grid
# can free, so ggh4x is used when available to free every panel.
# Horizontal bars: 95% VE-parameter interval (EVC) or exact 95% CI
# (seroprevalence). Coverage is a registry census and carries no bar.
# Vertical bars: exact 95% Poisson CI for the incidence rate.

theil_sen <- function(x, y) {
  ok <- is.finite(x) & is.finite(y)
  x <- x[ok]; y <- y[ok]
  if (length(x) < 3) return(NULL)
  cb   <- combn(length(x), 2)
  dx   <- x[cb[2, ]] - x[cb[1, ]]
  dy   <- y[cb[2, ]] - y[cb[1, ]]
  keep <- dx != 0
  if (!any(keep)) return(NULL)
  b <- median(dy[keep] / dx[keep])
  tibble(a = median(y - b * x), b = b,
         x1 = min(x), x2 = max(x))
}
 
fit_ts <- dat_inc |>
  reframe(theil_sen(inc, x), .by = c(metric, bin)) |>
  transmute(metric, bin, inc = x1, inc_end = x2,
            x = a + b * x1, x_end = a + b * x2)
 
free_all <- requireNamespace("ggh4x", quietly = TRUE)
 
p_inc_all <- ggplot(dat_inc, aes(inc, x, colour = region)) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = inc_lo, xend = inc_hi, y = x, yend = x)) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = inc, xend = inc, y = x_lo, yend = x_hi), na.rm = TRUE) +
  geom_point(size = 1.2) +
  geom_segment(data = fit_ts, inherit.aes = FALSE,
               aes(x = inc, xend = inc_end, y = x, yend = x_end),
               linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey40", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_text(data = cor_inc_all, aes(x = -Inf, y = Inf, label = lab),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, colour = "black", hjust = -0.08, vjust = 1.2,
            lineheight = 0.9) +
  {if (free_all)
    ggh4x::facet_grid2(metric ~ bin, scales = "free", independent = "all", , switch = "y")
   else
    facet_grid(metric ~ bin, scales = "free", , switch = "y")} +
  scale_colour_manual(values = pal_region) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(accuracy = 1)) +
  labs(x = "Cumulative incidence per 100,000", y = NULL, colour = "Region") +
  theme_epi() +
  theme(strip.placement = "outside")
```

## Under5: Sero vs cum

```{r}
# ===========================================================================
# 14. UNDER-5 CUMULATIVE INCIDENCE BY REGION
# ===========================================================================
# The all-age version compares child immunity against an outbreak measured in
# the whole population. Restricting both numerator and denominator to young
# children makes the incidence measure match what the immunity measures
# describe.
 
case_age_lo <- 0     # years, inclusive
case_age_hi <- 5     # years, exclusive
 
# Setting case_age_lo <- 1 excludes infants, who are not yet MCV1-eligible and
# so sit outside the coverage and EVC denominators (9-59 months). That is the
# cleaner age match; 0-5 keeps the group epidemiologically complete.
 
dedupe_cases <- TRUE
 
# ---- duplicate records ----------------------------------------------------
 
df_ep2 |> summarise(rows = n(), unique_ids = n_distinct(id))
df_ep2 |> count(id) |> filter(n > 1) |> nrow()
 
# ---- census denominator ---------------------------------------------------
# Census age band k covers [k-1, k), so under 5 is bands 1:5, not 1:4.
 
census_u5 <- df_census |>
  filter(age >= case_age_lo + 1, age <= case_age_hi) |>
  summarise(n = sum(n), .by = district) |>
  mutate(district = merge_thuduc(clean_district(district)),
         region   = assign_region(district)) |>
  summarise(n_census = sum(n), .by = region) |>
  drop_na(region)
 
census_u5
 
# sanity: under-5s should be a few percent of the all-age total
tibble(u5 = sum(census_u5$n_census), all_age = sum(df_census$n)) |>
  mutate(pct = 100 * u5 / all_age)
 
# ---- case numerator -------------------------------------------------------
 
cases_u5 <- df_ep2 |>
  (\(d) if (dedupe_cases) distinct(d, id, .keep_all = TRUE) else d)() |>
  filter(age >= case_age_lo, age < case_age_hi) |>
  mutate(district = merge_thuduc(.data[[col_district]]),
         region   = assign_region(district),
         date     = .data[[col_date]]) |>
  drop_na(region, date)
 
cases_u5 |> count(region)
cat("under-5 cases:", nrow(cases_u5), "of", nrow(df_ep2), "rows\n")
 
# ---- quarterly cumulative incidence ---------------------------------------
# Bins built from the full date range so the under-5 and all-age versions
# share a bin grid; regions with no cases in a quarter still get a row.
 
date_rng <- range(df_ep2[[col_date]], na.rm = TRUE)
bin_grid <- seq(floor_date(date_rng[1], "quarter"),
                floor_date(date_rng[2], "quarter"), by = "quarter")
 
inc_u5 <- cases_u5 |>
  mutate(bin = floor_date(date, "quarter")) |>
  count(region, bin) |>
  complete(region = census_u5$region, bin = bin_grid, fill = list(n = 0)) |>
  arrange(region, bin) |>
  mutate(cum_n = cumsum(n), .by = region) |>
  left_join(census_u5, by = "region") |>
  mutate(
    group  = as.character(region),
    inc    = cum_n / n_census * 1e5,
    inc_lo = qchisq(0.025, 2 * cum_n) / 2 / n_census * 1e5,
    inc_hi = qchisq(0.975, 2 * (cum_n + 1)) / 2 / n_census * 1e5
  )
 
inc_u5 |> select(group, bin, cum_n, n_census, inc) |> arrange(bin) |> print(n = Inf)
 
# ===========================================================================
# 15. IMMUNITY MEASURES VS UNDER-5 INCIDENCE
# ===========================================================================
# Reuses x_all from section 13 (coverage and EVC at snap_week, seroprevalence
# from each hospital's last collection period).
 
bin_keep <- as.Date(c("2024-07-01", "2024-10-01", "2025-01-01",
                      "2025-04-01", "2025-07-01", "2025-10-01"))
bin_lab  <- setNames(format(bin_keep, "%b %Y"), as.character(bin_keep))
 
dat_u5 <- x_all |>
  inner_join(inc_u5 |> filter(bin %in% bin_keep) |>
               select(group, bin, region, inc, inc_lo, inc_hi),
             by = "group") |>
  mutate(metric = factor(metric, levels = metric_lev),
         region = factor(as.character(region), levels = rank_order),
         bin    = factor(bin_lab[as.character(bin)], levels = unname(bin_lab)))
 
dat_u5 |> summarise(n = n(), .by = c(metric, bin)) |> print(n = Inf)
 
# ---- Spearman rho ---------------------------------------------------------
# Five regions per panel, and the six bins are nested cumulative counts, so
# read each row as a trajectory rather than as six independent tests.
 
cor_u5 <- dat_u5 |>
  summarise(
    n   = sum(is.finite(x) & is.finite(inc)),
    rho = if (n[1] >= 3) cor(x, inc, method = "spearman",
                             use = "complete.obs") else NA_real_,
    p   = if (n[1] >= 3) suppressWarnings(
            cor.test(x, inc, method = "spearman", exact = FALSE)$p.value
          ) else NA_real_,
    .by = c(metric, bin)
  ) |>
  mutate(lab = if_else(is.na(rho), "rho = NA",
                       sprintf("rho = %.2f\np = %.3f", rho, p)))
 
cor_u5 |> print(n = Inf)
 
# side by side with the all-age version, if section 13 was run
if (exists("cor_inc_all")) {
  cor_inc_all |>
    select(metric, bin, rho_all = rho) |>
    left_join(cor_u5 |> select(metric, bin, rho_u5 = rho), by = c("metric", "bin")) |>
    print(n = Inf)
}
 
# ---- Theil-Sen line, consistent with a rank correlation -------------------
 
theil_sen <- function(x, y) {
  ok <- is.finite(x) & is.finite(y)
  x <- x[ok]; y <- y[ok]
  if (length(x) < 3) return(NULL)
  cb   <- combn(length(x), 2)
  dx   <- x[cb[2, ]] - x[cb[1, ]]
  dy   <- y[cb[2, ]] - y[cb[1, ]]
  keep <- dx != 0
  if (!any(keep)) return(NULL)
  b <- median(dy[keep] / dx[keep])
  tibble(a = median(y - b * x), b = b, x1 = min(x), x2 = max(x))
}
 
fit_u5 <- dat_u5 |>
  reframe(theil_sen(inc, x), .by = c(metric, bin)) |>
  transmute(metric, bin, inc = x1, inc_end = x2,
            x = a + b * x1, x_end = a + b * x2)
 
# ---- figure ---------------------------------------------------------------
# Horizontal bars: exact 95% Poisson CI for the incidence rate.
# Vertical bars: 95% VE-parameter interval (EVC) or exact 95% CI
# (seroprevalence). Coverage is a registry census and carries no bar.
# Dashed line: Theil-Sen fit, an aid to reading direction, not a model.
 
p_u5 <- ggplot(dat_u5, aes(inc, x, colour = region)) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = inc_lo, xend = inc_hi, y = x, yend = x)) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = inc, xend = inc, y = x_lo, yend = x_hi), na.rm = TRUE) +
  geom_segment(data = fit_u5, inherit.aes = FALSE,
               aes(x = inc, xend = inc_end, y = x, yend = x_end),
               linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey40", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_point(size = 1.2) +
  geom_text(data = cor_u5, aes(x = -Inf, y = Inf, label = lab),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, colour = "black", hjust = -0.08, vjust = 1.2,
            lineheight = 0.9) +
  facet_grid(metric ~ bin, scales = "free", switch = "y") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = pal_region) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(accuracy = 1)) +
  labs(x = "Cumulative incidence per 100,000 children under 5",
       y = NULL, colour = "Region") +
  theme_epi() +
  theme(strip.placement = "inside")
 
p_u5
 
ggsave("figs/chap1/fig_immunity_vs_incidence_u5.png", p_u5,
       width = 9.5, height = 6.5, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
df_case_neg <- readRDS(file.path(path2data, cases_neg_file))

df_case_neg <- df_case_neg |> 
  filter(ngay_nv >= ep2$start, ngay_nv <= ep2$end)

df_summary <- df_case_neg |>
  mutate(
    age_group = cut(
      age,
      breaks = c(-Inf, 9 / 12, 5, 15, Inf),
      labels = c("<9m", "9m-5", "5-15", "15+")
    ),
    vax = factor(tiem_chung,
                 levels = c("Không", "Có", "Không rõ"),
                 labels = c("No", "Yes", "Unknown"))
  ) |>
  count(age_group, vax) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = vax, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) |>
  mutate(
    n_total = No + Yes + Unknown,
    # complete case: unknown excluded from numerator and denominator
    pct_cc  = 100 * Yes / (Yes + No),
    # lower bound: unknown counted as unvaccinated
    pct_lo  = 100 * Yes / n_total,
    # upper bound: unknown counted as vaccinated
    pct_hi  = 100 * (Yes + Unknown) / n_total
  ) |>
  transmute(
    age_group,
    No      = sprintf("%d", No),
    Yes     = sprintf("%d", Yes),
    Unknown = sprintf("%d", Unknown),
    n_total,
    `Complete case`  = sprintf("%.1f%%", pct_cc),
    `Unknown as no`  = sprintf("%.1f%%", pct_lo),
    `Unknown as yes` = sprintf("%.1f%%", pct_hi)
  )
 
df_summary
```

## Catchment vs cases address

```{r}
# ===========================================================================
# 16. SEROSURVEY CATCHMENT VS HOSPITAL ADMISSION CATCHMENT
# ===========================================================================
# Three maps per hospital: the district composition of collected serum
# samples, and the district composition of measles admissions in each
# outbreak period, plus a direct scatter of the two shares.
 
col_date <- "ngay_nv"     # admission date column in df_case
 
# ---- 16a. Hospital name normalisation -------------------------------------
# "Nhi đồng 1/2" anchored at end of string so "Nhi Đồng Đồng Nai" and
# "Nhi đồng Tp.Cần Thơ" cannot match. Diacritic case varies, so ignore_case.
 
hosp_map <- df_case |>
  as_tibble() |>
  mutate(
    hosp = case_when(
      str_detect(ten_bv, regex("nhi\\s*đồng\\s*1\\s*$", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "CH1",
      str_detect(ten_bv, regex("nhi\\s*đồng\\s*2\\s*$", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "CH2",
      str_detect(ten_bv, regex("nhi\\s*đồng\\s*thành\\s*phố\\s*$",
                               ignore_case = TRUE))                          ~ "CCH",
      .default = NA_character_
    )
  )
 
# CHECK: which names mapped where, and the totals
hosp_map |> count(hosp, ten_bv) |> filter(!is.na(hosp)) |> print(n = Inf)
hosp_map |> count(hosp)      # expect CH1 4422, CH2 3415, CCH 1185
 
df_case_3h <- hosp_map |> filter(!is.na(hosp))
 
# ---- 16b. Percentages from all three sources ------------------------------
 
ep_win <- tibble(
  panel = c("2018-2020", "2024-2025"),
  start = c(ep1$start, ep2$start),
  end   = c(ep1$end,   ep2$end)
)
 
ep_win      # confirm the labels match the actual episode date ranges
 
adm_pct <- ep_win |>
  reframe(
    df_case_3h |>
      filter(between(.data[[col_date]], start, end)) |>
      drop_na(district) |>
      count(hosp, district),
    .by = panel
  ) |>
  mutate(pct = 100 * n / sum(n), .by = c(panel, hosp)) |>
  transmute(panel, hospital = hosp, district, pct)
 
adm_pct |> summarise(n_dist = n(), total = sum(pct), .by = c(panel, hospital))
 
# CHECK: district strings must line up across sources
setdiff(unique(adm_pct$district), unique(df_map_pct$district))
setdiff(unique(df_map_pct$district), unique(adm_pct$district))
setdiff(unique(adm_pct$district), unique(df_map_hcmc$district_blank))
 
panel_lev <- c("Serum samples", "2018-2020", "2024-2025")
 
pct_all <- bind_rows(
  df_map_pct |> as_tibble() |>
    transmute(panel = "Serum samples", hospital = as.character(hospital),
              district, pct),
  adm_pct
) |>
  mutate(panel    = factor(panel, levels = panel_lev),
         hospital = factor(hospital, levels = levels(df_map_pct$hospital)))
 
# ---- 16c. Panel A: maps ---------------------------------------------------
# log2 of each district's share against the equal-share reference
# (100 / n districts), so white marks proportional representation, red above,
# blue below. Districts below pct_min draw grey. One shared scale.
 
pct_min <- 1                                             # below this % draws grey
mid     <- 100 / n_distinct(df_map_hcmc$district_blank)  # equal-share reference
 
map_pct <- pct_all |>
  complete(nesting(panel, hospital), district = df_map_hcmc$district_blank,
           fill = list(pct = 0)) |>
  mutate(lfc = if_else(pct < pct_min, NA_real_, log2(pct / mid))) |>
  left_join(select(df_map_hcmc, district_blank),
            by = c("district" = "district_blank")) |>
  st_as_sf()
 
lo <- log2(pct_min / mid)                 # bar starts exactly at pct_min
hi <- max(map_pct$lfc, na.rm = TRUE)
 
# four breaks only: six labels collide on a bar this width
brks_pct <- c(1, 5, 20, 40)
brks_pct <- brks_pct[log2(brks_pct / mid) >= lo & log2(brks_pct / mid) <= hi]
 
p_catch <- map_pct |>
  ggplot() +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = lfc), colour = "grey60", linewidth = 0.25) +
  facet_grid(hospital ~ panel, switch = "y") +

  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colours  = pal_gsea()(12),

    na.value = "grey92",
    rescaler = \(x, to = c(0, 1), from = range(x, na.rm = TRUE))
                 scales::rescale_mid(x, to, from, mid = 0),
    breaks   = log2(brks_pct / mid), labels = paste0(brks_pct, "%"),
    name     = "Share of samples or admissions",
    guide    = guide_colourbar(title.position = "top",
                               barwidth  = unit(5, "cm"),
                               barheight = unit(0.3, "cm"),
                               ticks.colour = "white",
                               frame.colour = NA)
  ) +
  theme_void(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    strip.text.x       = element_text(colour = "grey15", size = 11,
                                      margin = margin(b = 5)),
    strip.text.y.left  = element_text(colour = "grey15", size = 11, angle = 0,
                                      margin = margin(r = 6)),
    strip.placement    = "outside",
    strip.clip         = "off",
    legend.position    = "bottom",
    legend.title       = element_text(colour = "grey15", hjust = 0.5, size = 10),
    legend.text        = element_text(colour = "grey30", size = 9),
    legend.box.spacing = unit(2, "pt"),
panel.spacing.x    = unit(0.3, "lines"),
    panel.spacing.y    = unit(0.1, "lines"),
    plot.margin        = margin(4, 4, 2, 4)
  )
 
p_catch
 
# ---- 16d. Summary values for the description ------------------------------
 
n_dist  <- n_distinct(df_map_hcmc$district_blank)
tab_pct <- map_pct |> st_drop_geometry()
 
# sample size behind each panel
bind_rows(
  df_map_pct |> as_tibble() |>
    summarise(n = sum(n), .by = hospital) |> mutate(panel = "Serum samples"),
  ep_win |>
    reframe(df_case_3h |>
              filter(between(.data[[col_date]], start, end)) |>
              drop_na(district) |>
              count(hosp, name = "n") |> rename(hospital = hosp),
            .by = panel)
) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = panel, values_from = n) |>
  print()
 
# concentration: how few districts make up most of each catchment
tab_pct |>
  summarise(
    top1     = max(pct),
    top1_d   = district[which.max(pct)],
    top3     = sum(sort(pct, decreasing = TRUE)[1:3]),
    n_to_80  = which(cumsum(sort(pct, decreasing = TRUE)) >= 80)[1],
    n_over_1 = sum(pct >= 1),
    .by = c(hospital, panel)
  ) |>
  arrange(hospital, panel) |>
  print(n = Inf)
 
# agreement: Spearman rho and total variation distance (half the sum of
# absolute share differences, so 0 = identical, 100 = disjoint)
wide <- tab_pct |>
  select(hospital, panel, district, pct) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = panel, values_from = pct, values_fill = 0)
 
agree <- wide |>
  summarise(
    n       = n(),
    rho_ep1 = cor(`Serum samples`, `2018-2020`, method = "spearman"),
    p_ep1   = suppressWarnings(
                cor.test(`Serum samples`, `2018-2020`,
                         method = "spearman", exact = FALSE)$p.value),
    rho_ep2 = cor(`Serum samples`, `2024-2025`, method = "spearman"),
    p_ep2   = suppressWarnings(
                cor.test(`Serum samples`, `2024-2025`,
                         method = "spearman", exact = FALSE)$p.value),
    tvd_ep1 = sum(abs(`Serum samples` - `2018-2020`)) / 2,
    tvd_ep2 = sum(abs(`Serum samples` - `2024-2025`)) / 2,
    .by = hospital
  ) |>
  mutate(across(starts_with("rho"), \(x) round(x, 2)),
         across(starts_with("tvd"), \(x) round(x, 1)),
         across(starts_with("p_"),  \(x) format.pval(x, digits = 2, eps = 0.001)))
 
agree |> print()
 
# largest district-level discrepancies, which drive the TVD
wide |>
  mutate(d_ep1 = `Serum samples` - `2018-2020`,
         d_ep2 = `Serum samples` - `2024-2025`) |>
  slice_max(abs(d_ep2), n = 3, by = hospital) |>
  select(hospital, district, `Serum samples`, `2024-2025`, d_ep2) |>
  arrange(hospital, desc(abs(d_ep2))) |>
  print(n = Inf)
 
# districts each hospital effectively does not reach
tibble(equal_share = mid, n_districts = n_dist) |> print()
 
tab_pct |>
  summarise(n_below_1pct = sum(pct < 1), n_zero = sum(pct == 0),
            .by = c(hospital, panel)) |>
  arrange(hospital, panel) |>
  print(n = Inf)
 
# pairwise overlap between the three sample catchments
smp <- wide |> select(hospital, district, pct = `Serum samples`)
 
crossing(a = levels(smp$hospital), b = levels(smp$hospital)) |>
  filter(a < b) |>
  mutate(overlap = map2_dbl(a, b, \(x, y) {
    pa <- smp |> filter(hospital == x) |> arrange(district) |> pull(pct)
    pb <- smp |> filter(hospital == y) |> arrange(district) |> pull(pct)
    sum(pmin(pa, pb))          # shared share, 0 = disjoint, 100 = identical
  })) |>
  print()
 
# ---- 16e. Panel B: sample share vs admission share ------------------------
# aspect.ratio = 1 makes the panels square while letting them size to the
# available height, so B fills its cell instead of leaving side gaps.
 
p_agree <- ggplot(sc_dat, aes(pct_adm, pct_smp, colour = region)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dotted", colour = "grey50") +
  geom_point(size = 1.1, alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_text(data = lab_pos, aes(x = pct_adm, y = pct_smp, label = lab),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, colour = "black", size = 2.2,
            hjust = 0, vjust = 1, lineheight = 0.9) +
  facet_grid(hospital ~ panel) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = pal_region) +
  {if (use_log) {
     list(scale_x_log10(labels = \(x) paste0(x, "%"),
                        breaks = c(0.1, 1, 10)),
          scale_y_log10(labels = \(x) paste0(x, "%"),
                        breaks = c(0.1, 1, 10)))
   } else {
     list(scale_x_continuous(labels = \(x) paste0(x, "%")),
          scale_y_continuous(labels = \(x) paste0(x, "%")))
   }} +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = ax_lim, ylim = ax_lim) +
  labs(x = "Share of admissions", y = "Share of serum samples",
       colour = "Region") +
  theme_epi() +
  theme(aspect.ratio  = 1,
        text          = element_text(size = 8),
        axis.title    = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold"),
        axis.text     = element_text(size = 6.5),
        strip.text    = element_text(size = 8),
        panel.spacing = unit(0.25, "lines"))
 
# ---- 16f. Combined figure at 8 x 4.5 in -----------------------------------
# All sizes below are chosen for that canvas. Both panels put their legend
# in a bottom band of similar height so the panel regions line up.
 
p_catch_c <- p_catch +
  guides(fill = guide_colourbar(title.position = "top",
                                barwidth  = unit(3.2, "cm"),
                                barheight = unit(0.22, "cm"),
                                ticks.colour = "white",
                                frame.colour = NA)) +
  theme(legend.position    = "bottom",
        legend.title       = element_text(size = 7.5, hjust = 0.5),
        legend.text        = element_text(size = 6.5),
        legend.box.spacing = unit(0, "pt"),
        legend.margin      = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
        strip.text.x       = element_text(size = 8, margin = margin(b = 6)),
        strip.text.y.left  = element_text(size = 8, margin = margin(r = 3), face = "bold"),
        panel.spacing.x    = unit(0.9, "lines"),
        panel.spacing.y    = unit(0, "lines"),
        plot.margin        = margin(2, 4, 0, 2))
 
p_agree_c <- p_agree +
  guides(colour = guide_legend(nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE,
                               override.aes = list(size = 2))) +
  theme(strip.text.y       = element_blank(),
        legend.position    = "bottom",
        legend.direction   = "horizontal",
        legend.title       = element_text(size = 7.5, face = "bold"),
        legend.text        = element_text(size = 6.5),
        legend.key.size    = unit(0.55, "lines"),
        legend.box.spacing = unit(0, "pt"),
        legend.margin      = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
        plot.margin        = margin(2, 2, 0, 4))
 
p_comb <- (p_catch_c | p_agree_c) +
  plot_layout(widths = c(1.2, 1)) +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A") &
  theme(plot.tag          = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
        plot.tag.position = c(0.01, 0.99),
        plot.margin       = margin(t = 5, r = 4, b = 5, l = 2))
 
p_comb
 
ggsave("figs/chap1/fig_catchment_combined.png", p_comb,
       width = 6, height = 3.8, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```

```{r}
tab_pct <- map_pct |> st_drop_geometry()
tab_pct |>
  summarise(
    top1     = max(pct),
    top1_d   = district[which.max(pct)],
    top3     = sum(sort(pct, decreasing = TRUE)[1:3]),
    n_to_80  = which(cumsum(sort(pct, decreasing = TRUE)) >= 80)[1],
    n_over_1 = sum(pct >= 1),
    .by = c(hospital, panel)
  ) |>
  arrange(hospital, panel) |>
  print(n = Inf)

agree <- wide |>
  summarise(
    n       = n(),
    rho_ep1 = cor(`Serum samples`, `2018-2020`, method = "spearman"),
    p_ep1   = suppressWarnings(
                cor.test(`Serum samples`, `2018-2020`,
                         method = "spearman", exact = FALSE)$p.value),
    rho_ep2 = cor(`Serum samples`, `2024-2025`, method = "spearman"),
    p_ep2   = suppressWarnings(
                cor.test(`Serum samples`, `2024-2025`,
                         method = "spearman", exact = FALSE)$p.value),
    tvd_ep1 = sum(abs(`Serum samples` - `2018-2020`)) / 2,
    tvd_ep2 = sum(abs(`Serum samples` - `2024-2025`)) / 2,
    .by = hospital
  ) |>
  mutate(across(starts_with("rho"), \(x) round(x, 2)),
         across(starts_with("tvd"), \(x) round(x, 1)),
         across(starts_with("p_"),  \(x) format.pval(x, digits = 2, eps = 0.001)))
 
agree |> print()
```


## Sero of infants

```{r}
df_sero_infant |> 
  # 1. Convert age inline
  mutate(age_month = age * 12) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = age_month, y = titre)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 200, linetype = "dashed") +
  # Added alpha to prevent overplotting with your raw points
  geom_point(alpha = 0.4) + 
  # 2. Fit and plot the GLM in one step
  geom_smooth(
    method = "glm",
    method.args = list(family = Gamma(link = "log")),
    level = 0.95,
    colour = "blue" 
  ) +
  # Vaccination milestones
  geom_vline(xintercept = 9, linetype = "dashed", colour = "#D55E00", linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 12, linetype = "dashed", colour = "#0072B2", linewidth = 0.7) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(200, 500, 1000, 1500, 2000)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 12, 2)) +
  labs(
    x = "Age (months)",
    y = "Titer (mIU/mL)"
  ) +
  theme_classic()
```
